read.thesis: Record $268B backlog (book-to-bill 1.56) and 20% munitions output gains at Raytheon, with 2026 capex raised to $3.1B from $2.6B; supply additions are capacity-led but tied to firm demand.

triggers.quote: another $3.1 billion in CapEx on top of the $2.6 billion I just highlighted for last year

triggers.label: Backlog $268B, up 23%
triggers.quote: another record backlog of $268 billion, up 23% year over year

triggers.label: Raytheon munitions output up 20%
